messages:
Maya: Quick FYI  two procurement updates launching next week: sustainable-vendor requirements for larger contracts, and a net-30 payment pilot for qualifying startups. Short summary below + links. :seedling::money_with_wings:

Maya: 1) Sustainable Vendor Policy: vendors with anticipated annual spend > $10k must now provide a basic sustainability questionnaire (carbon footprint banding or published ESG report) as part of onboarding. 2) Startup Net-30 Pilot: qualifying early-stage vendors can opt into net-30 payment terms to help cash flow; apply via the portal.

Maya: Full docs: <https://redwood.internal/finance/sustainable-vendors|sustainable vendor policy> and <https://redwood.internal/finance/startup-net30|startup net-30 pilot>. Read before submitting vendor forms.

Carl: Question 1: how strict is the carbon data requirement? Will a one-page statement from the vendor suffice?

Maya: One-page vendor-provided summary is fine for most SaaS vendors. For >$50k spend, we require either a public ESG report or third-party verification. Procurement will flag incomplete submissions.

Ivy: Any exclusions for infrastructure vendors or cloud providers? They often have public sustainability pages but not custom reports.

Maya: Good point. Large cloud providers with public sustainability disclosures are considered compliant if they provide the link + statement. Infra vendors that handle customer data will still need security review as usual.

FinanceBot: Automated notice  sustainability questionnaire option enabled on vendor form. Vendors with estimated annual spend > $10,000 will be prompted. (logged at 1805000120)

Sam: For the startup net-30 pilot: what qualifies as "startup"? Revenue cutoff, age, or VC-backed?

Maya: Pilot criteria: <2 years since incorporation OR ARR < $1.5M OR VC-backed seed/pre-seed. Vendors must attest and provide bank/payment details. FinanceOps reserves the right to deny if credit risk is high.

Carl: Who signs off on net-30? Is it automated?

Maya: FinanceOps approves pilot enrollments. For spend > $25k on net-30 terms, director-level signoff required. We'll publish the approval matrix in the pilot page.

Ivy: Any changes to payment timetables for existing vendors? Or is this only for new enrollments?

Maya: Only new enrollments into the pilot. Existing vendors keep current terms unless they opt in and meet criteria.

FinanceBot: Reminder  vendors missing bank details will be auto-pended after 72 hours. (automated at 1805000200)

Sam: Will sustainability requirements affect vendor selection in procurement-approved lists? Could be good for vendor scorecards.

Maya: Yes  we'll add a sustainability attribute to approved-vendors and surface it on the vendor catalog. Procurement may prefer higher-scoring vendors for RFPs where applicable.

Carl: Timeline? When do these go live?

Maya: Both changes go live Monday 2026-05-11. Portal forms updated today. We'll host a 30-min office hour on Mon 10am for Q&A. Link in docs.

Ivy: Can we get a one-pager for PMs to explain the new checklist (what to ask vendors)? PeopleOps wants something short for onboarding.

Maya: Yep  I'll post a 1-page checklist + sample vendor statement by EOD Friday and ping @PeopleOps to include it in onboarding.

Sam: Thanks Maya  good to see procurement pushing sustainability. :leafy_green:

Maya: Thanks team. Ping me or @finance with edge cases.
